description:
The acs pipeline is hook-gated: every skill's pre-gate refuses to run until its upstream step has. This is the SPINE — the ordering every release depends on, independent of what v0.4.10 changed. Each of the 15 gated skills is driven through three workspace states, and the assertion is on the gate's exit code and the reason it gives, because the reason is what tells an operator (or a coordinator) which step to run next.

Profiles: bare = a fresh repo with settings and no tickets; ticketed = one open task ticket (TKT-1, small/low, needs_design false); epic = one open epic (TKT-1, large/high, needs_design true).
